entry.title: New: dsh-vision-subagent
entry.summary: Vision for text-only agents: a vision_agent tool that delegates image reading to a one-shot subagent on a configurable vision route (MiniMax/Kimi), plus a Codex-style paste bridge — images are analyzed on an isolated context and only text reaches the main session. Exact install spec: dsh-vision-subagent. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
